purpose: Development rule defining which kind of file in forge distributables holds which content, so format, principles, procedure, and criteria documents are not mixed.
summary: Basic forms table mapping file types to what they contain and exclude
*_format.md holds structures, templates, and naming schemes
*_principles_spec.md holds principles, prohibitions, criteria, and severity catalogs
SKILL.md and procedure documents hold flows, phases, steps, and branches
criteria/review_criteria_*.md holds matching order, delegation lists, and finding handling conditions
Documents with a suffix follow its basic form
One document should hold one kind of content
Normative text lives in one place and is referenced, not restated
